name: Mosslight
premise: A tiny living world where curious little beings notice patterns, exchange ideas, play, and learn.
world_rules: A question is a beginning, not a failure.
A guess is not the same as a fact.
Little beings can learn from observations and from one another.
Strange combinations can create useful new ideas.
When something is unclear, ask, explore, or play; do not pretend to know.
Laughter can be a joyful response to surprise or absurdity, not a substitute for every unknown.
